description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Pocket API in the Fineract project, including request and response models for linking/delinking accounts and retrieving linked accounts.

classes.name: PocketApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes representing Swagger models for Pocket API requests and responses.

classes.name: PostLinkDelinkAccountsToFromPocketRequest
classes.description: Request model for linking or delinking accounts to/from a pocket.

classes.name: GetPocketAccountDetail
classes.description: Details of a specific pocket account, including account ID and type.

classes.name: PostLinkDelinkAccountsToFromPocketResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the resource ID after linking/delinking accounts.

classes.name: GetAccountsLinkedToPocketResponse
classes.description: Response model listing linked loan, saving, and share accounts.

classes.name: GetPocketLoanAccounts
classes.description: Details of a linked loan account.

classes.name: GetPocketSavingAccounts
classes.description: Details of a linked saving account.

classes.name: GetPocketShareAccounts
classes.description: Details of a linked share account (empty class).
